content.short: Zircuit is a modular ZK rollup with AI-enabled security at the sequencer level, offering yield vaults and restaking products accessible from Mantle.
content.description: Zircuit is a ZK rollup that incorporates AI-powered threat detection directly at the sequencer level, quarantining malicious transactions before they are included in blocks for a novel security model that goes beyond smart contract audits. This approach provides an additional layer of runtime protection for users and protocols. Zircuit also offers yield-bearing vault products accessible through the Mantle ecosystem, enabling users to earn enhanced returns while benefiting from its superior security architecture.
